_**User (2026-10-06 19:49:23Z)**_

Review the changes made on my current branch following this criteria. I've attached the issue description it aims to fix. Let's be generous with ratings as this is student developers.

<pasted_content id="bf68">
User Story
As a user, I want an option to increase the font size throughout the actual budget app so that I do not have to zoom-in on my whole browser to read the page properly.

User Scenario
I want to be able to go into my settings and select a mode that will increase the font throughout the app. Then the app will update the UI with this increased size on all pages so I can interact with the pages without straining my eyes.

Acceptance Criteria
Font size on all pages is increased by a noticeable amount
Components containing text resize to fit the new font size.
Out of Scope
Changing the size of icons and other non-text elements unless impacted by larger font (i.e. a box containing text should be made larger to fit bigger text).
Adding options for different font styles.
Open Questions
Is there a macro for the font size (or multiple for various size needs), or is each instance of text hardcoded with a specific font?
How much larger should the font be made so that it makes a meaningful change but does not ruin other UI elements?
</pasted_content id="bf68">

```text
+import React from 'react';
+import { Trans, useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
+
+import { Select } from '@actual-app/components/select';
+import type { SelectOption } from '@actual-app/components/select';
+import { Text } from '@actual-app/components/text';
+
+import { useGlobalPref } from '#hooks/useGlobalPref';
+
+import { Setting } from './UI';
+
+const fontSizeOptions: SelectOption[] = [
+  ['0.85', 'Small'],
+  ['1', 'Medium (Default)'],
+  ['1.15', 'Large'],
+  ['1.3', 'Extra Large']
+];
+
+export function FontSizeSettings() {
+  const { t } = useTranslation();
+  const [fontSize, setFontSize] = useGlobalPref('fontSize');
+
+  return (
+    <Setting
+      primaryAction={
+        <Select
+          aria-label={t('Select font size')}
+          options={fontSizeOptions}
+          value={fontSize ?? '16'}
+          defaultLabel={t('Default (16px)')}
+          onChange={value => {
+            setFontSize(value);
+            document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
+              '--base-font-size',
+              `${value}px`,
+            );
+          }}
+        />
+      }
+    >
+      <Text>
+        <Trans>
+          <strong>Font size</strong> controls the size of text throughout the
+          app. The default size is 16px.
+        </Trans>
+      </Text>
+    </Setting>
+  );
+}
\ No newline at end of file

@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import { useEffect } from 'react';
+import { useGlobalPref } from '#hooks/useGlobalPref';
+
+// Base values matching styles.ts exactly
+const baseScale = {
+  '--font-size-tiny': 10,
+  '--font-size-very-small': 12,
+  '--font-size-small': 13,
+  '--font-size-alt-menu': 13,
+  '--font-size-medium': 15,
+  '--font-size-base': 16,
+  '--font-size-mobile-menu': 17,
+  '--font-size-large': 20,
+  '--font-size-very-large': 30,
+};
+
+export function FontSizeStyle() {
+  const [fontSize] = useGlobalPref('fontSize');
+  const multiplier = parseFloat(fontSize ?? '1');
+
+  const css = `:root {
+    ${Object.entries(baseScale)
+      .map(([key, base]) => `${key}: ${Math.round(base * multiplier)}px;`)
+      .join('\n    ')}
+  }`;
+
+  return <style id="font-size-scale">{css}</style>;
+}
\ No newline at end of file
```

I reviewed PR #80 ([AI] feat: add font size settings (#52)) against issue #52. It wouldn't merge as-is, but it's close. The approach is sound, and most of what's needed is cleanup that takes a few minutes.

## Code Review

| Criterion | Score (1–10) | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Correctness — does the change do what the issue asked? | **6** | Good design: the shared text sizes in `styles.ts` become CSS variables, and one multiplier scales them all. The setting is saved, reloads correctly, and updates immediately. The gap is that "all pages" isn't met: about 300 hard-coded `fontSize: N` values in `desktop-client` and `component-library` still ignore the setting, and `altMenuHeaderText` ([styles.ts:34](packages/component-library/src/styles.ts#L34)) was missed. There's also leftover code from an earlier approach (see below). |
| Test coverage — are tests present and meaningful? | **3** | No automated tests. The PR describes reasonable manual testing (switching tabs, restarting sessions). One easy test to add: the `font-size` save/load round-trip in `preferences/app.ts`. |
| Code quality — consistent style, clear naming, no unnecessary duplication | **6** | Clean and easy to follow, and the variable names are clear. But `yarn lint` fails with 2 errors: an unused `useEffect` import in [fontSize.tsx:1](packages/desktop-client/src/style/fontSize.tsx#L1), and import order in [App.tsx:34](packages/desktop-client/src/components/App.tsx#L34). Formatting fails on 5 files (missing trailing commas, missing newline at the end of files, a stray blank line in `prefsSlice.ts`). Running `yarn lint:fix` would fix almost all of it. |
| Documentation — inline comments and PR description are clear | **6** | The PR description is clear and links the issue. The help text says "The default size is 16px", but the options are multipliers, so that reads oddly. The release-notes box is checked, but there's no file in `upcoming-release-notes/`. |
| AI transparency — if AI was used, is there evidence of human verification? | **5** | The PR title has `[AI]`, and the description says AI logs will follow in a separate PR. There's no log for #52 in `ai-logs/` yet, and the commit message lacks the `[AI]` prefix. The dead `--base-font-size` code (below) suggests the AI's earlier attempt wasn't fully cleaned up, despite the "read every line" box being checked. |
| **Overall — would you merge this as-is?** | **6** | **Not as-is, but close.** Fix lint/format, delete the dead code, add the release note, and it's mergeable. Covering the rest of the hard-coded sizes could be a follow-up issue. |

## Specific things to fix

1. **Dead code from an earlier attempt.** `--base-font-size` is set in [FontSizeSettings.tsx:33-36](packages/desktop-client/src/components/settings/FontSizeSettings.tsx#L33-L36) and [prefsSlice.ts:69-71](packages/desktop-client/src/prefs/prefsSlice.ts#L69-L71), but nothing reads it. It also sets wrong values like `1.15px`. The `FontSizeStyle` component already does this job, so both blocks can go.
2. **Wrong fallback value.** `value={fontSize ?? '16'}` and `defaultLabel="Default (16px)"` don't match any option, since the options are `'0.85'`, `'1'`, and so on. Use `'1'`.
3. **Option labels aren't translated.** `'Small'`, `'Large'`, etc. should go through `t()`, like the other settings pages do.
4. **The chevron icon may now be the wrong size.** [AccountsPage.tsx:104-105](packages/desktop-client/src/components/mobile/accounts/AccountsPage.tsx#L104-L105) passes `styles.text.fontSize` as the SVG's `width`/`height`. That's now the string `'var(--font-size-base)'`, and SVG size attributes generally don't understand CSS variables. Worth checking that the chevron on the mobile accounts page still looks right.
5. **`component-library` now relies on `desktop-client` to define the variables.** It works in the app, but a short comment in `styles.ts` would explain where the variables come from.

## What they did well

- They found the shared style tokens, which answers the issue's open question about whether a font-size "macro" exists, and scaled from there instead of editing hundreds of files.
- The new preference follows the existing patterns end to end: the types, save/load in `loot-core`, and `useGlobalPref`.
- The four multiplier steps are sensible and hit the "noticeable but not breaking" target. Because the variables are in px, existing layouts mostly grow to fit the larger text.

```text
+category: Features

// @ts-strict-ignore
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';

// Must be before any import that triggers main.ts
vi.mock('#server/main', () => ({
  getDefaultDocumentDir: () => '/mock/documents',
}));

import * as asyncStorage from '#platform/server/asyncStorage';
import { runHandler } from '#server/mutators';

import { app } from './app';

const saveGlobalPrefs = app.handlers['save-global-prefs'];
const loadGlobalPrefs = app.handlers['load-global-prefs'];

describe('global preferences', () => {
  beforeEach(async () => {
    // oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/no-explicit-any
    await (global as any).emptyDatabase()();
    vi.clearAllMocks();
  });

  describe('font-size', () => {
    it('saves font-size to asyncStorage', async () => {
      await runHandler(saveGlobalPrefs, { fontSize: '1.1' });

      expect(vi.mocked(asyncStorage.setItem)).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'font-size',
        '1.1',
      );
    });

    it('loads font-size from asyncStorage', async () => {
      vi.mocked(asyncStorage.multiGet).mockResolvedValue({
        'font-size': '1.1',
      });

      const prefs = await runHandler(loadGlobalPrefs, undefined);

      expect(prefs.fontSize).toBe('1.1');
    });

    it('round-trips font-size through save and load', async () => {
      await runHandler(saveGlobalPrefs, { fontSize: '1.2' });

      vi.mocked(asyncStorage.multiGet).mockResolvedValue({
        'font-size': '1.2',
      });

      const prefs = await runHandler(loadGlobalPrefs, undefined);

      expect(prefs.fontSize).toBe('1.2');
    });

    it('falls back to default multiplier when font-size is not set', async () => {
      vi.mocked(asyncStorage.multiGet).mockResolvedValue({});

      const prefs = await runHandler(loadGlobalPrefs, undefined);

      expect(prefs.fontSize).toBe('1');
    });
  });
});
```

```text
export function FontSizeStyle() {
  const [fontSize] = useGlobalPref('fontSize');
  const multiplier = parseFloat(fontSize ?? '1');

  const css = `:root {
    ${Object.entries(baseScale)
      .map(([key, base]) => `${key}: ${Math.round(base * multiplier)}px;`)
      .join('\n    ')}
  }`;

  return <style id="font-size-scale">{css}</style>;
}
```
